coverage_explanation: Checks the startup red-green-blue sequence and wraparound, two holds on different colors, resumption without restarting at red, and complete shutdown. All three LED channels are checked together. Resume checks allow either preservation of the interrupted color's remaining time or a fresh two-second dwell on that color.
assumptions: The supplied Mega wiring overrides bench defaults: RGB channels are active HIGH on pins 2, 3, and 4; buttons on pins 5, 6, and 7 connect to GND and require INPUT_PULLUP.
Released buttons are explicitly driven HIGH and pressed buttons LOW.
The requirement does not specify whether a resumed color retains its remaining dwell time or receives a fresh two-second dwell; checks accept both.
Simultaneous-button precedence and the effect of resume after Off Mode are unspecified and are not tested.
A 200 ms settling allowance is used for button responses; checks avoid color-transition boundaries.
